title: AI opens up new revenue streams for Info Edge’s Naukri
summary:
Naukri generated Rs 60 crore in AI revenue in Q2 FY27, giving Info Edge an annualised revenue run rate of Rs 240 crore.

The post AI opens up new revenue streams for Info Edge’s Naukri appeared first on MEDIANAMA.
llm_summary: Naukri, the flagship job portal of Info Edge, has tapped artificial intelligence to unlock fresh income sources, pulling in roughly ₹60 crore in AI‑related revenue during Q2 FY 27. That performance translates to an annualized AI revenue run‑rate of about ₹240 crore, signalling a significant new growth vector for the company beyond its traditional recruitment services.
